faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Ayush Mission Kerala (NAM Kerala) for filling up vacant posts in Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Remedial Educator under the National Ayush Mission Kerala healthcare sector program on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Remedial Educator post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Remedial Educator position in this recruitment cycle as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Remedial Educator post is 14-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Remedial Educator recruitment is officially scheduled to take place on 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Early Childhood Special Education (DECSE) or a Diploma in Autism Spectrum Disorders, Hearing Impaired, or Intellectual Disability.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply for the Remedial Educator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years. Please check the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as Remedial Educator will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 19,600/- under the contract terms.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for NAM Kerala Remedial Educator Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Eligible candidates need to send their filled application forms to the designated address.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted to the District Programme Manager, National Ayush Mission, Arogya Bhavan Building, Thiruvananthapuram.
